_notes.title: The board's name, engraved on its top plate.
_notes.sources: Where the headlines come from, in the order the board cycles them: RSS or Atom feed addresses, "wikipedia" for Wikipedia's In the news and Top read, "hackernews" for the Hacker News front page, and "guardian" or "guardian:<section>" when a Guardian key is set. A source can also be {"url": "…", "tag": "BBC"} to pick the up-to-five-letter tag shown at the start of its rows.
_notes.rows: About how many headlines the board shows at once, 2 to 12; it sets the size of the flaps. Each row takes the lines its headline needs, so a phone shows fewer headlines and a big screen more, each one whole.
_notes.secondsPerFlip: Seconds each page of headlines stays up before the board flips to the next, 3 to 120. The settings sheet on the board can change it for that screen.
_notes.location: Where the weather line is for: {"lat": 51.5072, "lon": -0.1276, "name": "London"}; name is optional. null leaves the weather line off.
_notes.theme: amber (amber flaps on brushed brass), white (white flaps on brushed steel), or departures (black flaps with yellow letters). Each has a light and a dark look that follows the screen.
